CreateReadOnlyInstance.clientToken: Idempotency token, an ASCII string no longer than 64 characters.
CreateReadOnlyInstance.billing.paymentTiming: Payment method (Postpaid; read-only instances only support postpaid)
CreateReadOnlyInstance.instanceName: User-defined instance name. Requirements: 1) lowercase letters and digits allowed; 2) length limited to 1–64; defaults to {engine} + {engineVersion}
CreateReadOnlyInstance.volumeCapacity: Package disk size, in GB, incremented by 5GB. Cannot be smaller than the master instance disk. [See range](/doc/RDS/s/9jwvz0wd3#%E5%AE%9E%E4%BE%8B%E5%8F%AF%E9%80%89%E5%A5%97%E9%A4%90)
CreateReadOnlyInstance.diskIoType: Disk type. normal\_io: local SSD disk. cloud\_high: high-performance cloud disk. cloud\_nor: general-purpose SSD. cloud\_enha: enhanced SSD
CreateReadOnlyInstance.zoneNames: Specifies zone information. Empty by default, in which case the system selects automatically. You can query the list of available zones via the [Query Available Zone List](/doc/RDS/s/zka65zqz2) API. The zoneName naming convention is lowercase "country-region-zone sequence", e.g. Beijing zone A is "cn-bj-a". A read-only instance can only reside in a single zone, so only one zone can be specified here.
CreateReadOnlyInstance.vpcId: Same as the master instance's vpcId
CreateReadOnlyInstance.isDirectPay: Whether to make a direct payment. Default is false. Change orders set to direct payment are charged immediately without going through the payment flow
CreateReadOnlyInstance.subnets: The subnetId of the zone within a specific VPC. If the specified vpcId is a custom VPC, subnetId must be specified. You can query the list of subnets via the [Query Subnet List](/doc/RDS/s/Wka66184u) API. A read-only instance can only reside in a single zone, so only one SubnetMap can be specified here
CreateReadOnlyInstance.ovip: The ovip of the BLB access entry for the RDS instance. If this parameter is passed with a non-empty value, the BLB is requested using this value as the BLB ovip; otherwise a random IP is assigned to the BLB
CreateReadOnlyInstance.entryPort: The port of the BLB access entry for the RDS instance. If this parameter is passed with a non-empty value, the BLB is requested using this value as the BLB listener port; otherwise it defaults to 3306. Port range: 1024–65535
CreateReadOnlyInstance.resourceGroupId: Resource group ID. For example: RESG-bKMxbExtnoG
CreateReadOnlyInstance.replicaType: basic indicates a basic read-only instance, ha indicates a high-availability read-only instance. Defaults to basic if not specified
CreateReadOnlyInstance.isInheritMasterAuthip: Indicates whether the newly created read-only instance should inherit the master instance's IP whitelist configuration. true means inherit, false means do not inherit. Defaults to false (does not inherit the master instance's IP whitelist)
CreateReadOnlyInstance.purchaseCount: The number of instances to purchase. Default is 1, maximum is 10
CreateReadOnlyInstance.resourceType: Instance type, supports exclusive/shared, defaults to exclusive. exclusive indicates dedicated type, shared indicates general-purpose type
CreateReadOnlyInstance.autoRenewTime: Auto-renewal duration (no more than 3 when the unit is year, no more than 9 when the unit is month)
